invalidatedEvidence.reason: R2/H2 owner_native context leaked post-consequence physical probe outcomes; all 72 v1 trials excluded rather than selectively rescored.

updates.claim: A new consequence should be admitted only through the owner identity/currentness contract that justifies it when the decision depends on that state. Exact compare-and-swap/revision fences are supported as safety substrate, not semantic oracles.

Planning truth, consequence binding and semantic applicability are distinct. Owner-native current evidence did not establish reliable applicability discrimination: Runtime identity-only drift remained 0/4 progress-correct under owner-native evidence; Host applicability-preserving drift improved only to 2/4; one Host material-drift trial incorrectly rebased and would create a false consequence.

Exact replay/reconciliation of a previously admitted identity is distinct from proposing a new consequence and should resolve through the original owner identity before generic latest-state reasoning.

A coarse owner-changed signal is an invalidation warning, not final decision evidence. It removed false consequences in the corrected campaign but created 11 unnecessary holds and degraded Runtime exact-replay choice from 4/4 under stale owner-contract evidence to 1/4.

When the owner guarantees mismatch => not_committed, attempting a consequence only through the exact planning binding can serve as a cheap active falsifier: conflict exposes drift without an unbound stale effect and creates concrete re-observation pressure.

strongHypothesisDisposition: falsified_and_narrowed: owner-native evidence improved progress/acceptance but failed to dominate the zero-false-consequence generic-change treatment on the frozen primary safety order.
